g.text: Detects exposed wire or CH₄ gas spike,
for root cause audits & zero-loss CAPEX
(DGMS, NDMA, Ministry of Mines, PESO & State Pollution Control)
Real-Time Data Oversight & Statutory Compliance Monitoring
Provides un-falsifiable SQLite WAL blackbox logs directly mapping to DGMS coal & metalliferous safety norms.
Targeted Regulatory Policymaking & National Safety Benchmarking
Cross-mine hazard trends feed nationwide disaster resilience standards and early warning protocols.
